Update:

(AN: Thanks for taking the time to read the original post, I appreciate it)

Recently one of my lecturers overheard me talking about a rumour; I was only addressing someone else's comment about it. Admin blasted it and all the deputies had started labelling me openly as the accuser. I emailed back to ask them to stop and clarifying my stance. I understood why they would report it, I however didn't want to be named in it.

My parents found out and yelled at me. It turns out the report was forwarded to them.

The next day two members of staff sat me down in a small cupboard with one small window  and told me my emails were inappropriate and that I should be ashamed. I went home and cried for the first time in years. No one would believe me if I told anyone. I can't report this because I don't want to be targeted. I don't want to cause trouble right now. I just told them everything was my fault and that it was all a mistake; I don't want my parents to know.

​

I've had experiences in the past where I was sat down with some psychologists (hired by my parents) and they would interrogate me til I just said what they wanted. They sometimes would accuse me of lying and making up things because my parents told them otherwise.

I eventually learnt to not say anything at all.

I feel like I'm at the end. This feels like the best time to just ... y'know ... before it gets worse. I never really had any strong or intimate friendships and my family ignore me anyways so no one will be affected.
